description:
Represents the trace information of messages that pass through Exchange Online organizations.

TIP: Gets a specific message trace by ID. Returns full details including senderAddress, recipientAddress, subject, messageId, receivedDateTime, status, size, and additional routing information.

RISK LEVEL: MEDIUM. This response contains PII or authentication metadata (sign-ins, MFA factors, mail metadata, risk detections). Handle with care and avoid casual disclosure.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-message-trace
